info.name: Aquiline Order Sync Service
info.description: Local/staging test collection for the aquiline-sync-service API. Set the {{baseUrl}} variable to wherever the service is running (default http://localhost:3000).

request.description: Main flow: checks if the profile exists in Aquiline, creates it if missing, then upserts the order(s).
Expect a 400 with stage: validation — used to confirm Joi validation runs before Aquiline is ever called.
Task 2 (on demand). success:true only means the HTML was accepted, not that it was applied — check outcome/trackingUpdateStatus in the response.
For AliExpress/Walmart, replace with a carrier tracking number and add "carrier": "FEDEX"|"UPS"|"USPS"|"ONTRAC"|"WALMART"|"CAINIAO"|"GOFO"|"UNIUNI", and omit retailer.
Task 3 (on demand). Returns aquilineNumber/status/trackingUrl for the order.
